title: AegisRecorderVerificationReport.v1
description: Read-only verification result for one Aegis Recorder session directory containing fixed journal and supervision-sidecar members.
$comment: Structural contract artifact. The production standard-library fixed-v1 validator enforces this shape plus cross-field arithmetic; it does not interpret an arbitrary runtime schema. Evidence truth still requires verify ABSOLUTE_SESSION_DIRECTORY. A local PASS proves only Recorder-owned app-server stdio transport. A supervision-only row proves no transport claim. Authority flags are permanently false in v1.

anyOf.$comment: External JSON-integer semantics remain the nonnegative signed-64 range 0..9223372036854775807. The upper bound is intentionally absent here because that literal is outside the RFC 8785 exact integer domain used to freeze this schema. The fixed-v1 report validation implementation used by validate-report and by verify before emission must reject values above 9223372036854775807.

External JSON-integer semantics remain the signed-64 range -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807. Those endpoint literals are intentionally absent here because they are outside the RFC 8785 exact integer domain used to freeze this schema. The fixed-v1 report validation implementation used by validate-report and by verify before emission must reject values outside that range; the Windows-profile allOf additionally retains its exact unsigned-DWORD range.

The fixed-v1 report validation implementation used by validate-report and by verify before emission must reject larger values.
